name: 4-In-1 Multi Colour Ballpoint Pen With Carabiner
description: This 4-in-1 multi-color ballpoint pen with belt buckle is made of ABS material. The whole pen is very light, so you won't find it inconvenient when using it. This ballpoint pen can write with 4 different colors, black, blue, red and green. It is a useful and fun gift for students, children, office workers and more.Push down the color you want, to change color just push it down the other will jump up, suitable for highlighting important parts of text or notes.Convenient and portable. Suitable for your wallet, bag or even pocket, keychains can also hang on your bag.Custom logo is welcomed!
